theme: Task sleep, task yield and task local values

terms.definition: A call that pauses the current task for a set time without blocking its thread.
terms.example: Use task sleep to wait one second.
terms.code:
let start = ContinuousClock.now
try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
let took = ContinuousClock.now - start
print(took >= .milliseconds(50))

terms.definition: A call that lets the current task step aside so other tasks can run first.
terms.example: Call task yield inside a long loop.

terms.definition: A value that is attached to a task and can be read by its child tasks.
terms.example: A task local value follows the child tasks.

video.description:
Learn to explain how to wait politely and share context between tasks: Task Sleep, Task Yield & Task Local Value, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Task Sleep - A call that pauses the current task for a set time without blocking its thread.
Task Yield - A call that lets the current task step aside so other tasks can run first.
Task Local Value - A value that is attached to a task and can be read by its child tasks.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain Task Sleep, Task Yield & Task Local Value in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Task Sleep, Task Yield, Task Local Value 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Task Sleep - A call that pauses the current task for a set time without blocking its thread.
한국어: Task Sleep: 스레드를 막지 않고 현재 태스크를 정해진 시간 동안 멈추는 호출

Task Yield - A call that lets the current task step aside so other tasks can run first.

Task Local Value - A value that is attached to a task and can be read by its child tasks.
한국어: Task Local Value: 태스크에 붙어 있고 자식 태스크가 읽을 수 있는 값

dialogue.title: Wait without blocking
dialogue.setting: A slow loader and a long loop

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my loader waits with a `while` loop, and the app feels slow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do not wait in a loop. Use task sleep. Task sleep pauses the current task without blocking its thread.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does it block the thread like the old `sleep` call?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. With task sleep the thread is free for other work. The task only pauses.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And my other loop does heavy math for ten seconds.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then call task yield now and then. Task yield lets other tasks run first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will task yield make my loop slower?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A little, but the app stays responsive. That is a good trade.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I also want to pass the user name to child code without a parameter.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a task local value. A task local value is attached to the task, and child tasks can read it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A task local value is great for logging and request IDs.
